title: UNESCO and ICOM survey AI use in museums
discussion_signal: The post frames museum AI adoption as an emerging ethical, practical, and professional governance question. It also identifies a gap between visitor curiosity and institutional channels for asking questions, linking AI adoption to cultural mediation, trust, and institutional capacity.
linked_research_question: How do cultural institutions adopt AI while preserving trust, professional judgment, and meaningful visitor relationships?
limits: Individual professional account of a survey launch
